JPM.rationale: JPMorgan Chase demonstrates strong fundamental health with record Q1 2026 results: net income of $16.5B ($5.94 EPS, +17% YoY), revenue of $50.5B (+10% YoY), and ROTCE of 23%. The bank's diversified business model across CCB, CIB, CB, and AWM provides resilience, with CIB revenue up 19% and Payments achieving its fifth consecutive record quarter. Balance sheet strength is evident with CET1 at 14.3% and $1.5T in cash/marketable securities. However, trajectory shows some mixed signals: quarterly EPS from Q3 2025 to Q1 2026 shows volatility (5.07→5.24→5.07→5.94), and operating cash flow has been negative in two of the last three quarters.
